title: Number Friends
focus: Pairs that make 10, 20 and 100, doubles and halves, and rounding to a friendly number and fixing it after.

title: Pattern Spotters
focus: Work from the left, use the times-table facts you know to build the ones you don't, and think with friendly benchmarks.

title: Number Sense Builders
focus: Move between fractions, decimals and percentages, test divisibility from 2 to 11, estimate first and multiply smartly by 9, 11, 99 and 999.

title: Pattern Masters
focus: Squares from 1 to 30, the difference of squares, Vedic patterns explained with algebra, and a practice system for speed with accuracy.
